post.text: Not gonna lie…. My grandson will be trying this soon! 😎 https://t.co/XDiBtZuXxG
post.author_description: America First - @GuntherEagleman’s Twin Brother - 30 year LEO -  Retired Homicide Detective - Let’s do this!

description.description: A baby in a blue baby carrier is strapped onto the back of a large golden retriever dog as it walks through a home. The camera follows the dog and baby from the side and behind as they move through the living area and into a hallway.

tweetMedia.transcription: Oh my gosh, look at him! Baby boy, you hanging on? He's over the gate! He's loving it so much!
